Premium for one plan

Source: R/ratebook.R
plan_premium.Rd

Premium for one plan

Usage

plan_premium(
  m,
  x,
  plan,
  class = "Standard",
  frequency = "Annual",
  i = 0.045,
  S = 1000
)

Arguments

m

A mortality object from mortality_law().

x

Issue age.

plan

A plan code from plans().

class

An underwriting class from risk_classes().

frequency

"Annual" or "Monthly" (monthly premiums use the UDD m-thly annuity).

i

Effective annual interest rate.

S

Benefit: the sum assured, or the yearly income for the deferred annuity.

Value

The total premium for a year (for Monthly, 12 times each instalment).

Examples

plan_premium(mortality_law(), 40, "T20", "Smoker", S = 250000)
#> [1] 783.2338
